sn35.153:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– atthi nu kho bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma bhikkhu aññatreva saddhāya, aññatra ruciyā aññatra anussavā aññatra ākāraparivitakkā aññatra diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā aññaṃ vyākareyya:
sn35.153:1.2: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī”ti?
sn35.153:1.3: bhagavammūlakā no bhante, dhammā bhagavannettikā bhagavampaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata bhante, bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn35.153:1.4: tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti.
sn35.153:1.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn35.153:1.7: atthi bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma bhikkhu aññatreva saddhāya …pe… aññatra diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā aññaṃ vyākareyya:
sn35.153:1.8: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī”ti.
sn35.153:2.1: katamo ca bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma bhikkhu aññatreva saddhāya …pe… aññatra diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā aññaṃ vyākaroti: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī”ti:
sn35.153:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohoti pajānāti,
sn35.153:2.3: asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohaṃ, natthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohoti pajānāti:
sn35.153:2.4: yantaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohoti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohaṃ, natthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohoti pajānāti: api nu me bhikkhave, dhammā saddhāya vā veditabbā, ruciyā vā veditabbā, anussavena vā veditabbā, ākāraparivitakkena vā veditabbā, diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā vā veditabbā?
sn35.153:2.6: nanu me bhikkhave, dhammā paññāya disvā veditabbāti?
sn35.153:2.8: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma bhikkhu aññatreva saddhāya …pe… aññatra diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā aññaṃ vyākaroti:
sn35.153:2.9: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī”ti.
sn35.153:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā santaṃ vā …pe… kāyena
sn35.153:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohoti pajānāti,
sn35.153:4.2: asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohaṃ, natthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohoti pajānāti.
sn35.153:4.3: yantaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu manasā dhmamaṃ viññāya santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohaṃ atthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohoti pajānāti. asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohaṃ natthi me ajjhattaṃ rāgadosamohoti pajānāti. api nu kho me bhikkhave, dhammā saddhāya vā veditabbā …pe… diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā vā veditabbāti?
sn35.153:4.5: nanu me bhikkhave, dhammā paññāya disvā veditabbāti?
sn35.153:4.7: ayampi kho bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma bhikkhu aññatreva saddhāya aññatra ruciyā aññatra anussavā aññatra ākāraparivitakkā aññatra diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā aññaṃ vyākaroti:
sn35.153:4.8: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī”ti.
